chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Mansur ibn al-'Abbas, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from 'Abdullah ibn Muskan, from Muhammad ibn 'Abd al-Khaliq and Abu Basir, who said:

Abu 'Abdillah عليه السلام said: “O Abu Muhammad, with us, by Allah, is a secret from the secret of Allah, and knowledge from the knowledge of Allah. By Allah, neither a near-stationed angel can bear it, nor a sent prophet, nor a believer whose heart Allah has tested for faith. By Allah, Allah has not charged anyone with that other than us, nor has He taken anyone into servitude by that other than us.”

“Indeed, with us is a secret from the secret of Allah and knowledge from the knowledge of Allah. Allah commanded us to convey it, so we conveyed from Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, what He commanded us to convey. But we found for it no place, no people, and no bearers who could bear it, until Allah created for that a people who were created from a clay from which Muhammad and his family and his offspring عليهم السلام were created, and from a light from which Allah created Muhammad and his offspring, and He fashioned them by the فضل of His mercy from which He fashioned Muhammad and his offspring.”

“So we conveyed from Allah what He commanded us to convey, and they accepted it and bore that. Then that reached them from us, and they accepted it and bore it. And our mention reached them, so their hearts inclined toward our recognition and our hadith. Had they not been created from this, they would not have been like that. No, by Allah, they would not have borne it.”

“Then he said: Indeed, Allah created a people for Jahannam and the Fire, so He commanded us to convey to them just as we conveyed to those others. But they recoiled from that, their hearts shrank away, they rejected it back upon us, they did not bear it, they denied it, and they said: ‘A lying sorcerer.’ So Allah sealed their hearts and made them forget that. Then Allah released their tongues with some of the truth, so they speak it while their hearts deny, so that this may serve as a defense for His awliya' and the people of His obedience.”

“And were it not for that, Allah would not be worshipped in His earth. So He commanded us to refrain from them, and to veil and conceal. Therefore conceal from the one concerning whom Allah commanded refraining, and veil from the one concerning whom Allah commanded veiling and concealment.”

He said: “Then he raised his hand and wept and said: O Allah, these are surely but a small band, so make our life their life and our death their death, and do not set over them an enemy to You so that You afflict us through them. For if You afflict us through them, You would never be worshipped in Your earth. And may Allah bless Muhammad and his family and grant peace abundantly.”

key_terms.الْكِتْمَانِ: Concealment of truths from those unfit to receive them.
key_terms.جَهَنَّمَ: Hell, mentioned for those created for rejection and punishment.
key_terms.سِرًّا: A divine secret entrusted to the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام.
key_terms.طِينَةٍ: The originating clay from which certain people are described as created.
key_terms.عِلْمًا: Knowledge from Allah specifically granted in this context.
key_terms.مَعْرِفَتِنَا: Recognition and true knowledge of the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام.
key_terms.نُورٍ: A primordial light associated here with the creation of Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم and his progeny.
key_terms.يَحْتَمِلُهُ: To bear, carry, or endure the weight of this divine matter.

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about the secret knowledge of the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام and who can bear it?
ai.summary: This hadith describes a divinely entrusted secret and knowledge uniquely borne by the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام, and explains that only certain people created with a special receptivity can bear and accept it. It also distinguishes between those inclined toward recognition of them and those who reject and deny, while concluding with a supplication for the preservation of the small faithful group through whom worship of Allah continues on earth.

en.hubeali: Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Al Husayn, from Mansour Bin Al Abbas, from Safwan Bin Yahya, from Abdullah Bin Muskan, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Khaliq and Abu Baseer who said,

‘Abu Abdullahasws said: ‘O Abu Muhammad! With usasws are secrets from the Secrets of Allahazwj, and knowledge from Knowledge of Allahazwj. By Allahazwj! Neither can an Angel of Proximity bear it, nor a Mursil Prophetas, nor a Momin whose heart Allahazwj has Tested for the Eman. By Allahazwj! Allahazwj has not Encumbered anyone with that apart from usasws nor is Heazwj worshipped by anyone with that apart from usasws.

And with us<sup>asws</sup> there are secrets from the Secrets of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> and knowledge from the Knowledge of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>. Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Commanded us<sup>asws</sup> with it’s delivery, so we<sup>asws</sup> delivered it on behalf of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic what He<sup>azwj</sup> had commanded us<sup>asws</sup> with it’s delivery. But, we<sup>asws</sup> did not find a place for it nor a deserving one nor any bearers who could be bearing it until Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Created a people for that. They were Created from the clay from which Muhammad<sup>saww</sup> and the Progeny<sup>asws</sup> of Muhammad<sup>saww</sup> and his<sup>saww</sup> offspring were Created from, and from a Light from which Allah<sup>azwj</sup> had Created Muhammad<sup>saww</sup> and his<sup>saww</sup> offspring, and Made them with the Grace of His<sup>azwj</sup> Mercy from which Muhammad<sup>saww</sup> and his<sup>asws</sup> offspring had been Made.

Thus, we delivered on behalf of Allahazwj what Heazwj had Commanded with it’s delivery, and they accepted it and are bearing that. So we delivered that to them from us and they accepted it and are bearing it, and weasws delivered ourasws mention (Zikr). So their hearts inclined towards ourasws recognition and ourasws Ahadeeth. So, had they not been created from this, they would not have been like that. No, by Allahazwj, they would not have been bearing it’.

Then he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Created a people for Hell and the Fire. So He<sup>azwj</sup> Commanded us<sup>asws</sup> that we<sup>asws</sup> deliver to them just as we<sup>asws</sup> had delivered to those (Shias), and they were constricted from that, and their hearts were alienated and they rejected it upon us<sup>asws</sup> and they did not bear it, and they belied with it and they said, ‘A lying magician’. Therefore, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Sealed upon their hearts and they forgot that. Then Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Release their tongues with some of the truth, so they are speaking with it, and they hearts are in denial, it order for that to become a defence from His<sup>azwj</sup> Guardians<sup>asws</sup> and the people of His<sup>azwj</sup> obedience.

And had it not been for that, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> would not have been worshipped in His<sup>azwj</sup> earth. Thus, we<sup>asws</sup> ordered with the refraining from them, and the veiling, and the concealment. So they (Shias) concealed it from the ones whom Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Commanded from the rerefrainment from, and they veiled it from the ones whom Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Commanded with the veiling and the concealment from’.

He (the narrator) said, ‘Then heasws raised hisasws hands and wept, and said: ‘O Allahazwj! They are a fragmented few (a very small group), therefore Make ourasws way of living their way of living, and ourasws manner of death their manner of death, and do not Let Yourazwj enemies to overcome upon them so they would be grieved by them, for, if Youazwj let them to be grieved by them, Youazwj would not be worshipped in Yourazwj earth, ever! And Send Salawat upon Muhammadsaww and hissaww Pogenyasws, and Greetings of abundant greetings’.
en.sarwar: 5. Ahmad ibn Muhammad has narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from Mansur ibn al-‘Abbass from Safwan ibn Yahya from ‘Abdallah ibn Muskan from Muhammad ibn ‘Abd al-Khaliq and abu Basir who has said the following.

“Abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) said, ‘O abu Muhammad, with us there is a secret of the secrets of Allah and a knowledge of the knowledge of Allah. No angel, near to Allah or a prophet who is a messenger also and no believer whose heart Allah has tested for faith is capable to bear. By Allah, Allah has not required anyone to bear it except us nor has He required anyone to worship him in that way except us.

With us there is a secret of the secrets of Allah and a knowledge of the knowledge of Allah. Allah has commanded us to preach it We then preached what Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most gracious, had commanded us to preaCh However, we did not find a proper place for it or a people or bearers who accept it until Allah created certain tribes. These people were created from the clay out of which Muhammad and his descendants were created and from a light from which Allah had created Muhammad and his descendants. He made them with the excess of the making of His blessings out of which He had made Muhammad and his descendants.

We then preached what Allah had commanded us to preach then these people accepted and acknowledged that. [It reached them from us and they accepted and acknowledged it]. Our mention reached them and their hearts inclined towards us, recognizing us and our hadith. Had they not been created from this they would not have been as suCh No, by Allah, they would not have acknowledged.”

Then the Imam (a.s.) said, “Allah created certain tribes for Hell and fire. He then commanded us to preach to them as we had preached to them but to the later ones it seemed repugnant and their hearts felt hatred and they rejected it from us, did not acknowledge it and considered it as lies and they said, “They are magicians and liars.” Allah then placed a seal on their hearts and made them to forget. Allah then opened their tongue with some of the truth. Thus, they speak of it but their hearts are in denial. He uses it in defense of His friends and those who obey Him.

Had it not been there no one would have worshipped Allah on earth. He commanded us to withheld it from them, hide and conceal. You must also hide it from those that Allah has commanded to withheld from and hide from those that Allah has commanded to hide and withheld from.”

The narrator has said that the Imam (a.s.) then raised his hands and wept and said, “O Lord, this is a very small group. Make our lives as their lives and our death like their death. Do not make dominant over them any of Your enemies that would cause us suffer pains for their suffering. If You would allow it to cause pains to us because of their sufferings no one would worship You on earth. May Allah send blessing up on Muhammad and his Ahl al-Bayt and may (Your) peace and more peace be with them.”
